title: Clients that probe the MCP server of pw.migurei.ai
title_ja: pw.migurei.ai の MCP サーバーに来たクライアント
warning: Self-declared, not verified: every name and URL is what the client wrote in its own User-Agent header. Anyone can copy a user agent. 自己申告・未検証：名前と URL はクライアント自身が User-Agent に書いたものです。
source: Request log of pw.migurei.ai (Cloudflare Worker), which runs a public MCP server at https://pw.migurei.ai/mcp listed in the official MCP Registry; plus /.well-known requests on migurei.ai.
listed_when: The client requested /mcp (or a path under it), a /.well-known file whose name contains "mcp", or the OAuth metadata files the MCP authorization spec names (oauth-protected-resource, oauth-authorization-server; https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-06-18/basic/authorization).
family: Requests are grouped by the first product name in the user agent (or the name after "compatible;"). Shared HTTP libraries (kind http-library), browser-shaped strings (browser-like) and empty user agents are each one group: many unrelated operators share them.
actions_note: actions counts the JSON-RPC method of each POST body as the server logged it (known MCP method names only; anything else is "other"). other also holds HTTP GET/DELETE on the MCP endpoint and refused requests. Request bodies, arguments and results are not kept. requests_without_method: requests with no logged method (mostly /.well-known files).
privacy: No IP address, network, ASN, country, e-mail address or request body. URLs are only http(s) URLs the client put in its own user agent, without query string; e-mail addresses in user agents are dropped.

excluded.rule: Requests carrying a Parallel World experiment Run token (URL or cookie): our own agent experiments.
User agent migurei-ParallelWeb: our own scanner.
Source address in the lab's own-IP list (office line): our own tests, e.g. curl.

Requests from Vietnam: the team and both lab machines are there and not every line they use is in the own-IP list (our manual tests with macOS curl came from such lines). This can also drop an outside client located in Vietnam.

not_listed.why: Requested only other /.well-known files (for example agent.json, security.txt, traffic-advice), no MCP path.
